d: A family Christmas turns into chaos when Elizabeth returns home and must plan the annual charity event, with her free-spirited sister Sam. They must learn to work together or Christmas is ruined.
Sue becomes a link between the FBI and a rogue British agent  Jack gets close to his boss.
The team investigates a bomb explosion at a restaurant  Myles tries a new health regimen.
Sue and Jack investigate the kidnapping of a young woman  the team members try to stop their odd quirks.
Broken-hearted Brooke Yeardley makes her 30th birthday wish on the vision board she made as a teen. As her wishes start coming true, she finds out that life doesn't always follow a plan.
A mix-up over a purchase leaves amateur jeweler Melissa being enlisted by the CEO of the biggest jewelry company in Miami to help create a bridal line with the CEO's too-serious son, Jake.
